data.body: Fixed in commit 21ca6dde43 (local; pending merge to main). Root causes: (1) test-ticket-transition-error-message.sh captured full 'ticket create' output as the ID instead of tail -1 — test-harness bug, production code fine; (2) test-apply-attribution-trailers.sh mocked the stale attribution.enabled gate but the script's gate is now dso.workflow=ci-pr — updated all 18 read-config mocks; 56/56 pass. Wired tests/unit/**/test[-_]*.sh into run-script-tests.sh via find (auto-discovers future bash tests). All 22 unit bash tests pass under suite-engine (389 assertions, SUITE_ISOLATION_CHECK=1). Leaving OPEN until merged to main.
